title: build: validate that --rm and --force-rm require --layers or --no-cache
body:
Fixes https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30196

Buildah already rejects --rm and --force-rm when layers are disabled and no-cache is not set, since the flags have no effect in that case. I added the same validation to podman build so that --rm or --force-rm with --layers=false fails unless --no-cache is also given.

Signed-off-by: takinosh@redhat.com
